messages.author: 960e80f4821bedfb
messages.subject: NaNs Produced
parts:
Hello R users,

I am using the unmarked package to estimate detection probability and occupancy probability for 4 bird species as a function of several habitat covariates.  I have included the relevant code in the body of this message, but I can provide more, if needed.  Thank you for help and feedback, it is greatly appreciated.

Global1<-occu(~Sky+Noise+Obs~Habitat+Mgmt,MOSpring2013)
MuMIn:::fixCoefNames(names(coef(Global1)))
ms1<-dredge(Global1,beta=F,evaluate=T,rank="AICc",fixed=~p(Sky)+p(Noise)+p(Obs))
   When I run the ms1 this error is the result: In sqrt(diag(vcov(model))) : NaNs produced
ms1.topmodels4<-subset(ms1,delta<=4)
ms1.topmodels4
ms1.avg<-model.avg(ms1.topmodels4)
ms1.avg
summary(ms1.avg)

Is there a common reason why this error occurs?  I do not know why I received this error, and would appreciated this group's help in resolving the problem.

Thank you in advance,

Evan Hill

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] NaNs Produced
parts:
hi Evan,
 This probably suggests a non-identifibility problem -- covariates that are highly correlated or even redundant or a very bad likelihood solution (e.g., on the boundary of the parameter space).  You may be able to diagnose the problem by building the model up step-wise and looking at the results each time to see where the problem arises.
regards,
andy
